unit: Image tokens = prompt tokens (usage.inputTokens, Google promptTokenCount) of a request with text "a" and one image, minus prompt tokens of a request with text "a" alone.
gateway: Every request is pinned to one backend with providerOptions.gateway.only. `models` is the Vertex backend, which the gateway tries first. `modelsAiStudio` is the Google AI Studio backend, which the gateway falls back to. mediaResolution is sent as providerOptions.google.mediaResolution.

twoImagesAtHigh.error: Unable to submit request because the model supports HIGH media resolution only for single images.
